records.text: Andrew Kolvet's unnamed lieutenant-colonel brother said he never worked at Fort Huachuca and went there only once for a three-day training, two days of which were travel.

appearances.snippet: And I never worked at Fort Huachuca. I only went there once for a three-day training day. I don't know what that stands for. ... And two of those days were travel days as I visited my military police unit training with the base military police from Huachuca.

verification.notes: The source episode reads what it presents as an X post by Andrew Kolvet's lieutenant-colonel brother, including the denial of working at Fort Huachuca and the three-day-training explanation. The original post or another authenticated primary copy was not located in live search, so the quoted-post claim cannot be conclusively verified. No contradictory evidence justifies a false rating.
